custom_statements.name: reading_member_values
custom_statements.up:
CREATE FUNCTION reading_member_values(reading jsonb, datainfo jsonb)
RETURNS TABLE(member text, idx int, type text, v jsonb)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $fn$
  SELECT m.member, e.idx, e.type, e.v
  FROM (
    SELECT s.key AS member, s.value AS val, datainfo -> 'members' -> s.key AS di
    FROM jsonb_each(
      CASE WHEN datainfo ->> 'type' = 'struct' AND jsonb_typeof(reading) = 'object'
        THEN reading ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
    ) AS s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT (t.ord - 1)::text, t.val, datainfo -> 'members' -> (t.ord - 1)::int
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(
      CASE WHEN datainfo ->> 'type' = 'tuple' AND jsonb_typeof(reading) = 'array'
        THEN reading ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(val, ord)
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN m.di ->> 'type' = 'array'
      AND m.di -> 'members' ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled','enum','bool')
      AND jsonb_typeof(m.val) = 'array'
    THEN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.val) AS x(e)
      WHERE NOT CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(x.e) = 'number' THEN
      CASE
        WHEN m.di -> 'members' ->> 'type' = 'double' THEN
          abs(x.e::numeric) = 0
            OR (abs(x.e::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324
              AND abs(x.e::numeric) <= )
        WHEN m.di -> 'members' ->> 'type' IN ('int','scaled','enum') THEN
          CASE WHEN x.e::numeric = trunc(x.e::numeric)
            THEN x.e::numeric >= -9223372036854775808 AND x.e::numeric < 9223372036854775808
            ELSE false
          END
        ELSE false
      END
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(x.e) = 'boolean' THEN m.di -> 'members' ->> 'type' = 'bool'
    ELSE false
  END
    )
    ELSE false
  END AS array_ok OFFSET 0) AS k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 1 AS idx, m.di ->> 'type' AS type, m.val AS v
    WHERE m.di ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled','enum','bool')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 0, 'length',
      to_jsonb(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.val) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(m.val) END)
    WHERE k.array_ok
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.ord::int, m.di -> 'members' ->> 'type', a.val
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(
      CASE WHEN k.array_ok THEN m.val ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
    ) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(val, ord)
  ) AS e
$fn$

custom_statements.up:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW reading_numbers_1m
WITH (
  timescaledb.continuous,
  timescaledb.materialized_only = true,
  timescaledb.create_group_indexes = false
) AS
SELECT
  r.parameter_id,
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', r."timestamp") AS bucket,
  (u.ord - CASE WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'array' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS idx,
  min(ARRAY[u.v, round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8]) AS lo,
  max(ARRAY[u.v, -round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), -r.id::float8]) AS hi,
  sum(u.v) AS sum,
  count(*) AS count,
  min(ARRAY[round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8, u.v]) AS first_key,
  max(ARRAY[round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8, u.v]) AS last_key

FROM readings r
JOIN parameters p ON p.id = r.parameter_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(
  CASE
    WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled')
      THEN ARRAY[coalesce(r.value_float, r.value_int::float8)]
    WHEN p.datainfo -> 'members' ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled')
      THEN ARRAY[coalesce(cardinality(r.value_float_array), cardinality(r.value_int_array))::float8]
        || coalesce(r.value_float_array, r.value_int_array::float8[])
    ELSE ARRAY[coalesce(cardinality(r.value_int_array), cardinality(r.value_bool_array))::float8]
  END
) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, ord)
WHERE (
    p.datainfo ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled')
    OR (p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'array' AND p.datainfo -> 'members' ->> 'type' IN ('double','int','scaled','enum','bool'))
  )
  AND abs(u.v) < 1e290
GROUP BY r.parameter_id, bucket, idx

WITH NO DATA

custom_statements.up:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW reading_states_1m
WITH (
  timescaledb.continuous,
  timescaledb.materialized_only = true,
  timescaledb.create_group_indexes = false
) AS
SELECT
  r.parameter_id,
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', r."timestamp") AS bucket,
  u.ord::int AS idx,
  coalesce(u.i, CASE WHEN u.b THEN 1 WHEN NOT u.b THEN 0 END) AS state,
  min(r."timestamp") AS first_at,
  max(r."timestamp") AS last_at,
  count(*) AS count

FROM readings r
JOIN parameters p ON p.id = r.parameter_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(
  CASE
    WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'enum' THEN ARRAY[r.value_int]
    WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'array' AND p.datainfo -> 'members' ->> 'type' = 'enum'
      THEN r.value_int_array
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'bool' THEN ARRAY[r.value_bool]
    WHEN p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'array' AND p.datainfo -> 'members' ->> 'type' = 'bool'
      THEN r.value_bool_array
  END
) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(i, b, ord)
WHERE (
    p.datainfo ->> 'type' IN ('enum','bool')
    OR (p.datainfo ->> 'type' = 'array' AND p.datainfo -> 'members' ->> 'type' IN ('enum','bool'))
  )
  AND coalesce(u.i, CASE WHEN u.b THEN 1 WHEN NOT u.b THEN 0 END) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.parameter_id, bucket, idx, state

WITH NO DATA

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW reading_member_numbers_1m
WITH (
  timescaledb.continuous,
  timescaledb.materialized_only = true,
  timescaledb.create_group_indexes = false
) AS
SELECT
  r.parameter_id,
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', r."timestamp") AS bucket,
  m.member,
  m.idx,
  min(ARRAY[CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END, round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8]) AS lo,
  max(ARRAY[CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END, -round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), -r.id::float8]) AS hi,
  sum(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END) AS sum,
  count(*) AS count,
  min(ARRAY[round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END]) AS first_key,
  max(ARRAY[round(date_part('epoch', r."timestamp") * 1e6), r.id::float8, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END]) AS last_key

FROM readings r
JOIN parameters p ON p.id = r.parameter_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL reading_member_values(r.value_json -> 'value', p.datainfo) AS m
WHERE p.datainfo ->> 'type' IN ('struct','tuple')
  AND NOT r.value_json ? 'type'
  AND m.type IN ('double','int','scaled','length')
  AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
    CASE WHEN abs(m.v::numeric) < 1e290
        AND (m.v::numeric = 0 OR abs(m.v::numeric) > 2.4703282292062328e-324)
        AND (m.type NOT IN ('int','scaled')
          OR (m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
            AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
            AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808))
      THEN m.v::numeric::float8 END
  END IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.parameter_id, bucket, m.member, m.idx

WITH NO DATA

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW reading_member_states_1m
WITH (
  timescaledb.continuous,
  timescaledb.materialized_only = true,
  timescaledb.create_group_indexes = false
) AS
SELECT
  r.parameter_id,
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', r."timestamp") AS bucket,
  m.member,
  m.idx,
  CASE
    WHEN m.type = 'enum' AND jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
      CASE WHEN m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
          AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
          AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808
        THEN m.v::numeric::bigint END
    WHEN m.type = 'bool' AND jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'boolean' THEN
      CASE WHEN m.v = 'true'::jsonb THEN 1::bigint ELSE 0::bigint END
  END AS state,
  min(r."timestamp") AS first_at,
  max(r."timestamp") AS last_at,
  count(*) AS count

FROM readings r
JOIN parameters p ON p.id = r.parameter_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL reading_member_values(r.value_json -> 'value', p.datainfo) AS m
WHERE p.datainfo ->> 'type' IN ('struct','tuple')
  AND NOT r.value_json ? 'type'
  AND m.type IN ('enum','bool')
  AND CASE
    WHEN m.type = 'enum' AND jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'number' THEN
      CASE WHEN m.v::numeric = trunc(m.v::numeric)
          AND m.v::numeric >= -9223372036854775808
          AND m.v::numeric < 9223372036854775808
        THEN m.v::numeric::bigint END
    WHEN m.type = 'bool' AND jsonb_typeof(m.v) = 'boolean' THEN
      CASE WHEN m.v = 'true'::jsonb THEN 1::bigint ELSE 0::bigint END
  END IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.parameter_id, bucket, m.member, m.idx, state
